description: Search recorded AI coding-agent runs (your own Flatbread account's, and public runs on flatbread.io) for one that already did a similar task. Use it BEFORE starting a task that someone may have solved before, or after hitting an error, to find a run that hit the same wall. Returns run IDs; pass one to flatbread_get_brief for what that run learned.

harness.description: Only runs from this agent harness

query.description: Two to four words from the task or the error. Runs with every word in their title or ID come first; when none has them all, the closest are listed, marked with how many words they share

name: flatbread_search_traces
title: Search Flatbread runs
